verdict.rationale: Dropbox ships a native e-signature product, Dropbox Sign. Its docs say you can send signature requests from Dropbox, sign documents without leaving Dropbox, and automatically save signed documents to storage. Plans include 'Edit PDFs and get signatures', and there is a documented Send Signature Request API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-Dropbox signing workflow, and detail on which plans include signing and any limits.
